observations: All twelve final PNGs were independently opened: full stage and face crop for baseline and candidate in adult wide, child narrow normal, and infant narrow high contrast views.
The adult wide images preserve the existing close-up. Hand placement, fingertips, ear, nose, face and neck silhouette have the same visible size and position.

The child candidate keeps the head and supporting hand prominent while giving the head a balanced margin. Fingertips, thumb and palm contact remain readable. The earlier rejected upper-body composition is gone.

The infant candidate shows the complete left head edge and nose with visible clearance. The supporting hand and fingertip contours remain large enough to inspect, and the head still fills most of the narrow stage width.
The tighter sphere computed from actual vertices addresses the original mobile clipping without the excessive pullback seen in the rejected box-sphere candidate. Accept this final framing.
limitations: Independent visual review of the twelve pinned raw-module images. Geometry, state and camera preservation claims are supported separately by the CPU, raw test and browser evidence. Full application loader/build/deployment were not tested.
